title: deps: body-parser@^2.4.0
body:
Bumps `body-parser` to `^2.4.0`, which fixes CVE-2026-111181 ([GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828)), a DoS through trailing bytes after a compressed request body.

body-parser 2.4.0 was published on Oct 22, so CI will hit the `min-release-age=7` check in `.npmrc` until Oct 29. Tests pass locally with the gate turned off.

Fixes #7562
